---
title: "Get started with altdown"
---

altdown builds a pkgdown-style website for an R package with
[altdoc](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/) and Quarto. This guide sets up a
package, builds its site, and publishes it on GitHub Pages.

## Set up

From the root of your package, run:

```r
altdown::use_altdown()
```

This writes `altdoc/altdown.yml`, the one configuration file you edit, and adds
the files the build generates to `.gitignore` and `.Rbuildignore`.

## Build the site

```r
altdown::build_site()
altdoc::preview_docs()
```

`build_site()` builds the site into `docs/`, and `altdoc::preview_docs()` opens
it in your browser.

::: {.callout-important}
Examples in the man pages and code in the vignettes run against the installed
version of your package, so install it before building, e.g. with
`devtools::install()`.
:::

The site is built from what's already in your package:

- **Home page**: `README.md`, with a sidebar of links, the license, citation and
  developers taken from `DESCRIPTION`. Badges between `<!-- badges: start -->`
  and `<!-- badges: end -->` move into the sidebar.
- **Reference**: one page per `man/*.Rd` file, and an index of them.
- **Get started**: the vignette named after the package, like this one.
- **Articles**: every other vignette, including those in `vignettes/articles/`.
- **Changelog**: `NEWS.md`.

## Organize the reference index

By default the reference index lists every function in one section. To group
them, edit the `reference:` field in `altdoc/altdown.yml`. It has the same shape
as pkgdown's:

```yaml
reference:
  - title: Setting up
    contents:
      - use_altdown
  - title: Building
    contents:
      - starts_with("build_")
```

`?build_site` lists the other fields: `articles:` sets the order of the
"Articles" menu, and `quarto:` changes the Quarto configuration, e.g. to add
navbar links.

## Publish on GitHub Pages

altdoc can write a GitHub Actions workflow that builds the site and deploys it
to the `gh-pages` branch on every push:

```r
altdoc::setup_github_actions()
```

The workflow calls altdoc directly, so in `.github/workflows/altdoc.yaml`,
change the "Build site" step to call altdown instead:

```yaml
      - name: Build site
        run: |
          install.packages(".", repos = NULL, type = "source")
          install.packages("pak")
          pak::pak("BjarkeHautop/altdown")
          altdown::build_site(parallel = FALSE, freeze = FALSE)
        shell: Rscript {0}
```

Then, on GitHub, set the repository to serve Pages from the `gh-pages` branch
(*Settings* → *Pages*).

[Technical details](technical.qmd) explains how a build works and how altdown
makes an altdoc site look like pkgdown.
